fileFixtures.description: spec 创建父目录，fixture 驱动 Write 工具在用户批准胜出后创建目标文件。
Blocking PermissionRequest hook script: logs started, sleeps for 120s, and outputs no decision; referenced by an absolute path in user config (.cf/cli/config.json in the isolated E2E HOME).

Hook lifecycle trace: appended at runtime by the blocking hook installed via helper; the spec uses the started log to prove the race is real, and uses the absence of settled-without-decision to prove the hook did not participate in the decision.

requests.description: Case-local title generation response for the initial E2E_PERMISSION_HOOK_RACE message.
requests.syntheticReason: The initial E2E_PERMISSION_HOOK_RACE message triggers the default title sidecar; pins the case-local title response to prevent default replay from falling back to legacy provider-basic, and uses this initial marker to isolate cross-case matching.

requests.description: HK16 race regression: Write tool_use triggers a permission dialog in default mode while simultaneously launching a blocking PermissionRequest hook.
requests.syntheticReason: Write is a destructive tool requiring approval; after the confirmation dialog and blocking hook appear concurrently, the spec approves from the UI side to verify first-to-respond wins in the permission-responder-race.

requests.description: HK16 race regression: tool_result fed back after user approval wins → final text.
requests.syntheticReason: When the broker response wins while the hook is still blocked, the tool executes immediately; the model produces final text based on tool_result, proving the turn no longer waits for hook completion.
